_readme: Laravel-specific architecture rules template. Copy to .backend-suite/arch-rules.json and fill in the TODO values. See the main arch-rules.json.template for the base template with all available sections.

errorHandling._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_error_handling.php. Every key is this project's name for its own error machinery; the audit refuses rather than guessing them, because a wrong name matches nothing and reports a confident zero.

contractHeaders._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_contract_headers.php. Optional keys the script also reads, each documented at its top: namePrefix, sectionLabels, ignoreFields, checks, screenTreeDepth, receiverPattern, receiverName, screenClassPattern, scope, adapterGlob, excludeGlobs, outputPrefixes, baseline.

layerBoundaries._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_layer_boundaries.py. Every rule in rules[] is enforced (an earlier version read rules[0] only); baseline is the recorded oracle the ratchet compares against. On a PHP project mustNotImport may name a namespace root (App\Http\) or a repo-rooted path — both compare by prefix, and one rule may ban both.

rules.label: HTTP layer must not import Service layer
Service layer must not import HTTP layer

apiConsistency._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_api_consistency.py. checks: each of the four (loadBearingCopy, hardBakedCopy, authoredSemantics, vocabulary) is true or {"enabled": false, "why": "..."} — an unconfigured check refuses rather than passes. authoredSemantics is a client-UI-provenance check (an interaction must author a named semantics node); on a server-side tree the interaction surface lives in the client app, so turn it off with a why rather than letting every route report as an unnamed interaction. vocabularyRules: this project's own naming rules, [{message, classPattern?, classNotPattern?, has, hasNot?}] — a class whose name matches, whose members all match has, and whose members match none of hasNot is a finding; vocabulary on with zero rules refuses rather than sweeping clean.

authoredSemantics.why: server-side tree; interaction surfaces live in the client app

vocabularyRules.message: uses fetch, where the codebase names this find
uses find, where the codebase names this fetch

routeCoverage._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_route_coverage.php. routesGlob: glob for route files. actionPattern: regex to extract controller@method from 'uses' => 'Controller@method'. controllerDirs: directories to scan for controllers.

cacheTtlCoverage._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_cache_ttl_coverage.php. routesGlob: glob for route files. actionPattern: regex to extract action key from 'uses' => 'Controller@method'. ttlConfigGlob: glob for TTL config file. ttlKeyPattern: regex to extract action key from TTL config.

formRequestValidation._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_form_request_validation.py. requestDirs: directories containing FormRequest classes. requireRules: require rules() method. requireAuthorize: require authorize() method. requireMessages: require messages() method. requireAttributes: require attributes() method. forbidDuplicateRules: forbid duplicate field rules. forbidEmptyRules: forbid empty rules array.

routeModelBinding._comment: Consumed by bin/audit_route_model_binding.php. routesGlob: glob for route files. controllerDirs: directories to scan for controllers. modelDirs: directories to scan for Eloquent models. bindingPattern: regex for Route::model/bind. checkControllerSignatures: whether to check controller method signatures. allowMissingModels: whether to allow missing models for resource routes.

endpointParity._comment: verifies route/controller-action parity for string-action routes; no extra config needed

rateLimit._comment: public v4 API is globally throttled via the v4 group + RateLimiter::for('v4')
